Container.Name: DiscVault
Container.Overview: DiscVault is a physical 4K UHD/Blu-ray/DVD collection manager with barcode lookup, web UI, backup/restore, and MCP endpoint. This all-in-one container runs frontend, backend API, and MCP service together.

Config.Name: MCP Port (optional direct access)
Config.Description: Optional direct MCP service port. MCP is also available via /mcp on the Web UI port.

Config.Name: Data Path
Config.Description: Persistent data path (database, posters, profiles, backups).

Config.Name: OMDb API Key
Config.Description: Optional OMDb API key for metadata lookup.

Config.Name: TMDb API Key
Config.Description: Optional TMDb API key for metadata lookup.

Config.Name: RP_ID
Config.Description: WebAuthn relying party ID (domain only, no protocol/port).

Config.Name: RP_ORIGIN
Config.Description: WebAuthn relying party origin (full URL used by clients).

Config.Name: JWT Secret
Config.Description: JWT signing secret. Leave empty to auto-generate once, or set explicitly.

Config.Name: Legacy password authentication
Config.Description: Opt-in password and TOTP capability. Existing installs must also enable it in Users & roles with a fresh passkey.

Config.Name: MCP API Key
Config.Description: Optional API key for MCP authentication.
